basic_info.description: Seize the opportunity to own a well maintained mixed-use building in a prime San Francisco location at the intersection of 41st Ave and Balboa. This exceptional property boasts over 3,300 square feet of combined living and commercial space. The top residential unit features a full flat with breathtaking ocean views, including four good size rooms and two full baths. The commercial unit has been leased to an excellent business owner for decades, ensuring a steady stream of income. Each unit has its own separate meters, providing convenience and efficiency for both tenants and owners. Additional features include a two-car side-by-side parking garage, a rare find in the city. Nestled just blocks away from the vibrant Balboa Village, this location offers easy access to delightful restaurants, cafes, bakeries, and shops. The iconic Golden Gate Park and the serene Ocean Beach only minutes from your doorstep. This is an outstanding opportunity to own a piece of Outer Richmond's thriving community, with its strong investment potential, it promises significant returns and adds prestige to any portfolio.
